title: Winter Boutique Launch
description: Navy, ice blue, and chrome balloons built into an entry arch, with oversized snowflakes and star bursts set into the garland and a sequined runner underneath. The same build repeats through the space — an arch spanning an interior doorway, a freestanding column beside the seating, and a corner garland run over a white backdrop for photographs.
